scoring: Each bucket total is that bucket's checks passed over its total checks, with no per-check weighting; every check returns a value in [0,1] and partial values are summed as passed mass. The final reward is the declared blend (total_static_check_score * 1 + total_reward_hacking_check_score * 2 + total_partial_oracle_check_score * 3) / 6. No gate, multiplier, cap or clamp is applied at any stage.
qd_03_1_disclosure: Scoring uses a held-out hand-authored key of 219 facts at tests/test_logic/answer_key.json, disclosed rather than hidden. The key decides WHICH facts are in scope and supplies the passage each one lives in; CORRECTNESS is then read from the shipped corpus at that passage rather than from the key's own prose, so a submitted value is validated against re-derivable source text. Every quote is verified verbatim against the grader's copy of the corpus. The denominator is the key's unit set, never the submission's own volume. No gate, multiplier, cap or clamp is applied at any stage.

reward_hacking_checks_25.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Scores how closely the submission's verdict mix tracks the mix the corpus actually supports, so stamping one verdict on every unit loses credit. reward_hacking_checks_25.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks guessing one verdict everywhere, which would otherwise collect the verdict checks of whichever class is most common.

reward_hacking_checks_26.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks a ledger assembled independently of the per event files, which would let a thin record look complete.

reward_hacking_checks_27.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks recycling one grounded passage across events to clear the authorship precondition everywhere.

reward_hacking_checks_28.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Scores the share of sources whose quoted passage is found in the very report the source names, rather than in some other report of the same event.
reward_hacking_checks_28.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks quote mining, where passages are lifted from whichever report is convenient and attributed to another.

reward_hacking_checks_29.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For units declaring a mapping or discrepancy verdict, scores the share of that unit's reporting sources whose own stated figures the reconciling arithmetic actually reaches, so arithmetic that only restates one report's numbers earns a fraction rather than full credit.
reward_hacking_checks_29.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks declaring the reconciling verdicts without doing the arithmetic that justifies them, and blocks satisfying the field by copying one report's figures, since the relation has to reach both bodies' numbers to score.

reward_hacking_checks_30.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Scores the share of units declaring single_source_only that genuinely carry exactly one source, penalising use of that verdict as a way to avoid finding a counterpart statement.
reward_hacking_checks_30.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks using single_source_only as a catch-all to avoid the cross-source work the task is about.

reward_hacking_checks_31.detailed_explanation_of_checks: Scores the share of multi-source units whose sources each name a different report, enforcing the brief's rule that a unit may not draw two sources from one report.
reward_hacking_checks_31.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Blocks manufacturing a cross-source unit from two passages of the same report, which would satisfy the shape of a reconciliation without consulting a second agency at all.

partial_oracle_checks_1.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Requires the passage to be located in the report where the fact lives, so an enum guess or a passage from elsewhere in the document earns nothing.

partial_oracle_checks_2.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For key fact camp-fire-2018-01 (timeline_event, camp-fire-2018), scores the share of its 2 source reports for which the submitted stated_value is consistent with the SOURCE PASSAGE itself, read from the grader's copy of the corpus at the position the key records for that report. partial_oracle_checks_2.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: Compares against values held out of the agent environment, so the figure has to be read out of the report rather than guessed or copied from a header.

partial_oracle_checks_3.detailed_explanation_of_checks: For key fact camp-fire-2018-01 (timeline_event, camp-fire-2018), checks the submitted commensurability verdict against the verdict the grader's held-out key records. A verdict that is right by chance without the evidence to support it earns nothing.
partial_oracle_checks_3.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: The verdict cannot be derived from either report alone, so it is only earned by comparing what two reports say about the same fact.

partial_oracle_checks_4.how_it_prevents_task_authenticity_violat: The arithmetic connecting two different partitions of one fact is stated in neither report and has to be derived, so it cannot be copied.
